Name: Deck Toolkit
Description: Two-key volume slider with mute, Twitch live status, monitor input switching (DDC/CI), battery level of Bluetooth devices, SwitchBot Bot via Bluetooth and a safe shutdown key.

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.switch.Name: Monitor Input
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.switch.Tooltip: Switches a monitor input (HDMI / DisplayPort / USB-C) via DDC/CI. Can also toggle between two inputs.

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.headset.Name: Battery
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.headset.Tooltip: Battery level of a Bluetooth headset, controller, mouse … (or a SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless via USB).

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.volume.Name: Volume
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.volume.Tooltip: Volume down / up / mute for the default or any audio device. Two keys side by side form one slider.

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.twitch.Name: Twitch Channel
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.twitch.Tooltip: Shows whether a Twitch channel is live (grey = offline). Press opens the stream.

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.shutdown.Name: Safe Shutdown
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.shutdown.Tooltip: Shuts the PC down only after a second press within 3 seconds.

com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.bot.Name: SwitchBot Bot
com.lysgarrt.decktoolkit.bot.Tooltip: Presses a SwitchBot Bot directly via the PC's Bluetooth (no hub needed).
